shortDescription: Hong Kong’s economy grew robustly in the third quarter, paving the way for what may be its strongest annual expansion in five years, Financial Secretary Paul Chan said, according to Bloomberg, citing Radio Television Hong Kong.

title: Paul Chan Says Hong Kong’s 2026 Growth May Be Strongest in Five Years
